subject: Tiered availability ladder + launch-bridge pricing for BrightCart
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@brightcart.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Availability ladder & rapid escalation — Q4 packaging question

Hi Sofia,

We’re ramping BrightCart Checkout AI in early November and need to lock in an SLA + premium support package before our procurement review next week. High-level ask: an availability ladder (99.5 / 99.9 / 99.95), clear response windows for Sev1/Sev2, and an option for a 30-day “launch bridge” with faster human escalation and surge capacity.

Estimated baseline: ~3M tokens/month initially (see attached). We’re sensitive to both monthly unit economics and being able to escalate to an on-call engineer during severe incidents (phone or Slack pager).

Questions:
- Can you provide a concise pricing matrix for the three availability tiers?
- How would a 30-day launch bridge be billed and what SLAs does it guarantee?
- Do you offer short-term discounts for a 12-month commit, and what would that look like?

We’ll need this by EOD Tuesday to include in our procurement packet. CC’ing procurement.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Platform
BrightCart

Attachments: BrightCart_Q4_usage_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice@brightcart.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability ladder & rapid escalation — Q4 packaging question

Hi Alice — thanks for the estimate and timeline. Quick read below; I’ve attached a short pricing matrix and a draft escalation playbook.

Summary (short):
- Standard (entry): 99.5% uptime, email support (business hours), P1: 8-hr response, price: list $6k / month.
- Priority (recommended for Checkout): 99.9% uptime, 24/7 phone triage + 1-hr P1 response, daily incident updates, price: list $18k / month.
- Assured (enterprise): 99.95% uptime, named on-call, 30-minute P1 response SLA, quarterly SLO reviews, price: list $30k / month.

Discounting options (examples):
- 12-month minimum commit: 10-18% depending on prepay / volume bands.
- Volume tiers reduce per-token cost beyond 5M tokens.

Launch Bridge (30 days):
- Rapid ramp staffed 24/7 with an on-call escalation path and guaranteed triage <30 minutes for P1s.
- Includes temporary surge capacity (additional GPU pool on priority routing) billed at a flat daily rate plus overage tokens.
- Can be added to any tier as a one-time 30-day add-on.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached Redwood_Premium_Tiers_v2.pdf with a clean table and a suggested bridge fee band.
2) If you can confirm expected start date for the bridge and whether procurement prefers monthly invoices vs prepay, we’ll return a formal quote and a DocuSign for the 12-month option.

Timeline: we can turn this around within 24 hours once you confirm the bridge window.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: Redwood_Premium_Tiers_v2.pdf (pdf), Redwood_Escalation_Playbook.docx (docx)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Availability ladder & rapid escalation — internal pricing note

Internal — quick negotiating levers for BrightCart:

- Priority list: $18k/mo. Recommend offering 10% off for 12-month commit; 18% off if customer prepays 6 months (strategic account incentive).
- Include 5 hours/month of on-call engineering time for P1 triage in Priority at the 10% level; additional hours billed at $250/hr.
- Launch Bridge: flat rate of $6k/day for up to 30 days + standard token overage. Alternatively cap bridge at $120k total for very large launches to simplify procurement.
- SLA credits: standard formula (minutes down / total minutes in month) * monthly fee * 1.5. Keep multiplier to 1.5 to avoid outsized exposure.
- Add-ons: rollback assistance (3 engineers, 4 hours) and post-mortem support (included in Assured).

Marcus — do we approve 18% prepay for BrightCart given their checkout-critical nature and Q4 timing? If not, propose 15% flat.

-Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
vanessa@redwood.com
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice@brightcart.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability ladder & rapid escalation — Q4 packaging question

Alice — thanks for the details and the estimate. We’ve reviewed internally and can make the following firm offer for BrightCart’s November launch: 

Offer (final):
- Priority package (recommended): $18,000/month list. With a 12-month commitment we’ll extend a 15% discount = $15,300/month.
- Includes: 99.9% uptime SLA, 24/7 phone escalation, 1-hour P1 response SLA, 5 hours/month on-call engineering for triage, named CSM, monthly launch review for first 3 months.
- Launch Bridge (30 days): included at no additional flat fee for this customer (we’ll include surge capacity; token overages billed at standard overage price). This is a one-time concession for Q4 launches.
- SLA credits per downtime formula as Vanessa suggested (minutes down / minutes in month * monthly fee * 1.5).

Next steps: I’ll have legal and finance prepare a 12-month SOW and DocuSign for signature (link below). Please confirm start date for the bridge window and whether procurement prefers net-30 invoicing or prepay.

DocuSign: https://redwood.sign/docusign/BRG-1183
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/BRG-1183

Looking forward —
Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123
